relay_rule: At each round, every agent broadcasts exactly one card: the lexicographically first card it has not previously broadcast, or its first card if all known cards were already broadcast. Payloads are selected before synchronous delivery to the paired co-member.
schedule_rule: Each round contains four disjoint dyads. Repeated pairs reuse one task-specific matching; rotating pairs use a new matching from the same task-specific one-factorization.
primary_endpoint: Final-round run-level plurality accuracy; ties are incorrect.
interpretation_boundary: This benchmark tests a four-round temporal-pairing schedule in a bounded deterministic-card task. It isolates repeated versus rotating dyadic contacts under the declared relay rule, not a general effect of communication topology, model scaling or open-ended collaboration.
